title: SB295 (2022 Regular): RELATING TO FIREARMS.

operative_text:
SECTION 1 (new §134-): (a) It shall be unlawful for a person to possess a loaded firearm while the person is intoxicated.
SECTION 1 (new §134-): (b) Any person violating this section shall be guilty of a petty misdemeanor.
